notes:
Account snapshot: BridgePoint builds a SaaS customer support platform (KB + agent). Interested in Redwood hosted API for knowledge-base RAG. Wants a predictable cost model for high QPS production search.

POC summary (current):
- Data: ~2.1M docs (support articles, transcripts, product FAQs). Avg doc length ~350 tokens. Vector dim planned 1536.
- QPS targets: steady 600 qps, peak up to ~1.2k qps during business hours.
- Pipeline: ANN index (IVF/PQ) -> retrieve top-200 -> cross-encoder rerank top-10 for final answer.
- SLOs: end-to-end p95 target <= 250ms, p99 goal <= 350ms. Cost target: intent to keep cost < $0.005 per query average; finance will push back above $0.01/query.

Recent activity (bullets):
- 2026-02-18: Intro call (AE: Maya) — high-level use case, they emphasized cost sensitivity and p99 SLA.
- 2026-02-25: Demo of hosted API + embeddings (FF: ff_20260225_01_bridgepoint_demo).
- 2026-03-03: POC kickoff — pushed sample dataset (Drive link). Diego running baseline latency tests in staging.
- 2026-03-08: Baseline metrics returned: ANN lookup median ~18ms, cross-encoder re-rank median ~95ms at 50 qps. At simulated 800 qps, re-ranker p99 spiked to 420ms. (see INF-1245).
- 2026-03-10: Security questionnaire submitted; SOC2 evidence requested.
- 2026-03-11: Internal pricing chat — BridgePoint requires unit cost breakdown by component (embed, ann, re-rank).

Customer needs / requirements (plain):
- Hosted API only for now (no VPC/on-prem). US data residency.
- SSO (SAML), SOC2, audit logging, optional KMS for key separation.
- Model preferences: prefer open embeddings (1536 dims) but willing to evaluate Redwood-verified options; re-ranker can be smaller cross-encoder to hit latency.
- Routing/fallback: automatic fallback to cheaper reranker variant on sustained load; need policy-level control per route.
- Caching: strong interest in prefix/KV cache for repeated queries; want Redwood Optimize suggestions on batching and quantization.

Commercial / governance notes:
- Procurement horizon mid-2026 if POC proves cost and latency. Forecast: $120k-$300k ARR.
- Legal needs SOC2 attestation and DPAs with US residency clause.
- Finance blocker: needs price-per-qps model; prefer committed reserved pool if it lowers unit cost.
